shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Three uniformly-efficient per-level sizes (126/190/254) bought from a 146,000-cell budget. Wall-mounted junction and breaker boxes bridge power and pipe networks between levels across six supported utility mods. Per-colony climate bands make high levels genuinely alpine. LIVE IN OPEN BETA as Workshop item 3776015553, movement-and-pathfinding update shipped.
body:
> **NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 utility networks; §31 publishing; §32 pathing cost; §33 cross-level drafted movement; §34 walkable islands; §35 cross-plateau cost clamps; §36 perf probe; §37 mechs; §38 per-game static state; §39 flecks; §40 open bug: the mining router. Keep every ⚠ - each cost a run to learn.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED. ~86 files, ~27,000 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

# 0. START HERE

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from above, (2) performance, (3) vanilla parity.

**CURRENT PHASE: BUILD MODE.** Workshop item **3776015553** (public, open beta). **⚠ `Assemblies/` HOLDS A DEBUG DLL** - any upload needs `dotnet build -c Release` in `Source/` LAST, then strip per `RESTORE-MANIFEST.txt`. See §31.

**⚠ §9's run log records AGENT-DRIVEN runs only.** The user tests tiers, utility networks, the elevator and the multi-hop router outside Modmixer.

**⚠⚠ THE FOUR RULES THIS PROJECT PAID THE MOST FOR:**
1. **NOTHING COSMETIC MAY SIT ON THE PATH THAT DECIDES WHETHER A TRANSIT HAPPENS** (§33c) - and its selection-side twin: **CLAMP AT SELECTION, NEVER AT MOVEMENT** (§35).
2. **NEVER PATCH `RegionAndRoomUpdater.TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`** - ~4,500 calls/frame; use `map.events.RegionsRoomsChanged` (§34e).
3. **REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER** (§34b). Anything answering "can this pawn walk there" must flood CELLS with the diagonal rule, never `Region.Neighbors`.
4. **COUNT THE EMITTERS** (§39). The below view has THREE draw sources and pawn state has FIVE session-static homes; both bugs of run #384 were a missed member of a set that was assumed complete.

---

## Status
Visuality, QOL, altitude/weather, settings VERIFIED. **✅ §24b ✅ §24c ✅ §27 ✅ §28 ✅ §29 (#260).**
**✅ §2 NEW LADDER generates clean.** **✅ §30 ALL 15 NETWORKS LINK AND ARE EXERCISED.**
**✅ §32b DOOR/PAWN BAND SCOPE VERIFIED (#294).**
**✅ §33 CROSS-LEVEL DRAFTED MOVEMENT WORKS END TO END (#302).** **✅ §33a PATH LINE FIXED (#305).**
**✅ §34 WALKABLE ISLANDS VERIFIED (#308).** **✅ §35 COST CLAMPS VERIFIED (#309).**
**✅ §36 PERF PROBE FLOWN (#315) + CIRCINUS CROSS-READ.** **✅ §34f CLOSED: island flood 0.78 ms.**
**✅ §33h TRANSIT DISPATCH HOLE FIXED AND VERIFIED (#384).** **✅ §37 MECH COMMAND RANGE VERIFIED BY THE USER (#384): "mechs draft across levels fine now".**
**✅ #384 ALSO PROVED: multi-hop (band 2 -> 1 -> 0 as two legs), mech autonomous cross-band hauling AND construction, colonist Ingest/HaulToCell/HaulToContainer across bands.**
**🔧 §36e-C1 + §36c-B1 BUILT, UNVERIFIED - signatures in §36f.**
**🔧 §38 PER-GAME STATIC RESET + §39 BELOW-FLECKS BUILT, build green, UNVERIFIED - signatures in §38b / §39b.**
**⛔ §40 MINING ROUTER BUG OPEN - found in #384, NOT fixed. Cross-band mining never routes.**
**⛔ §33c ENTRY ANIMATION REVERTED.** Pop-out only; `ReadyToCarry` BUILT, NOT WIRED.
**🔧 §8b, §25, §30a, §33g BUILT, UNVERIFIED.** **🔧 §32a NEVER FIRED** (needs a raid).
**🎨 ART: 87 of 90 riser textures are placeholders. DISCLOSED. HEADLINE BETA GAP.**
**⚠ CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT IS PARTIAL** - down works, up does not render. DISCLOSED.

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount * Slot)`. `Slot = ceil((bandHeight + 2) / 64) * 64`; **64-alignment of SLOT is load-bearing**.

**The one insight.** `Region.Neighbors` is *topological, not spatial*. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms, temperature or vacuum. Reachability is not a path: 1.6's pathfinder is jobified and cannot traverse a synthetic link, hence segmented movement (§3).

**⚠⚠ AND THAT IS THE SOURCE OF §34.** `CanReach` answers "can I get there USING STAIRS"; the pathfinder answers "can I walk there NOW". **Every `CanReach=True` + `path=NOT FOUND` stall is that gap.**
**⚠ THE TOPOLOGICAL TRICK DOES NOT GENERALISE TO UTILITY NETWORKS** (§30).
**⚠ THE GUTTER IS UNBUILDABLE BY CONSTRUCTION.** **⚠⚠ AND ALREADY 100% UNPATHABLE IN EVERY MODE, INCLUDING FLYING. DO NOT "HARDEN" IT.**
**⚠ THE MOD IS DOWNWARD-ONLY IN THREE PLACES.** `TryResolveVisibleBelow`; the see-through click rule; the combat renderer. **§33b/§33f are the worked examples.**
**Hard 1.6 constraints.** No `PathFinder.FindPath`. **⚠ The stack is 2x to 7x anisotropic.** Pathfinder cost: **§32**.
**⚠⚠ ANISOTROPY BREAKS EVERY RAW DISTANCE TEST IN THE GAME.** `BandOf` CLAMPS (never returns -1), so a naive `DistanceTo` silently measures through the stack instead of failing loudly. §37 is the worked example.

### ⚠ THE SLICING RULE, nine shapes
| Shape | Example | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Anchor, a fraction of `Size.z` | river/lake centre; VEE Crater | remap the point |
| Field, a gradient on map centre | coastline; VEE LoneIsland | re-centre the sample |
| Noise space, a slice is not a short map | Map Preview; GL grids; Rimefeller oil | generate full height, then crop |
| Distance-to-extent | `CloseToEdge`; river WIDTH | re-base onto the band rect |
| Aspect ratio, normalised by BOTH dims | preview + reroll grid | lay out from the BAND, generate at the STACK |
| Map-wide scalar | snow melt, temperature, GL roof sweep, **mech command radius (§37)** | rewrite per cell at the consumer |
| Foreign absolute writes | GL landform lands in band 0 | ORDER, not arithmetic |
| Radius search wider than the gutter | `ConnectMaxDist` 6 vs a 3-cell gap | clip the rect to the band |
| **Whole-map list sweep** (§32) | every door / every pawn, per path request | bucket the list per band |

Unaudited: Basin, Cavern, Chasm, Cliffs, Hollow, Valley. **`ABBandLocal.cs` is THE canonical FIELD rewrite** plus `BandLocalModule`.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN — budget 146,000, ladder 7 / 4 / 2

| size | slot | gutter | gap | cost/band | playable | max levels | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 126 | 128 | 2 | 3 | 16,128 | 98.4% | 7 (cap) | 112,896 |
| **190** | 192 | 2 | 3 | 36,480 | 99.0% | **4** | 145,920 |
| 254 | 256 | 2 | 3 | 65,024 | 99.2% | 2 | 130,048 |

**⚠ EXACTLY ONE MAXIMALLY EFFICIENT HEIGHT PER 64-STEP** (`slot - 2`). **⚠ UNIFORM GUTTER IS A TESTING WIN.** **⚠ 318 blocked by arithmetic; 62 deliberately absent.** **⚠ 200 IS THE ONE NUMBER TO AVOID.** **Waste is a SAWTOOTH.**
**Old saves are safe.** **⚠ THE PLAN PERSISTS BETWEEN COLONIES.** **⚠ Own the widget, do not patch the data.**

# 3-8a. MOVEMENT, MASS, CAMERA
**Cross-band movement** segmented at ONE interception (`Pawn_PathFollower.StartPath`); hops strictly decrease. **Multi-hop verified in play (#384).**
**⚠⚠ TWO CARRY TRIGGERS - THE SWEEP AND `PatherArrived` - AND NOTHING MAY GATE EITHER** (§33c). **⚠⚠ AND THEY MUST AGREE ON THE ENDING, NOT JUST THE TRIGGER** (§33h).
**⚠ ONE DESCENT RULE: `TryResolveVisibleBelow`.** ELEVEN systems share it (§39 is the newest).
**⚠ THE BELOW VIEW IS MIRRORED PASSES.** **⚠ THREE THINGS ARE CALLED "MASS".** **⚠ VISIBILITY IS `ABBands.ShowsBelow(terrain)`.**
**⚠ EVERY FOREIGN NETWORK SHIPS ITS OWN `SectionLayer` AND NONE ARE MIRRORED** (§30f).
**Water** is TWO-PASS SCREEN-SPACE, **all three patches inert under GL**.
**⚠ PERSPECTIVE MODE WAS BUILT AND REMOVED.**
Ore `x(1+0.45*(depth-1))`. **⚠ The snow line WORKS as of §16's melt rewrite; its patch pair is lifetime-gated (§36e-C1).** Camera clamp + level-switch share `ABGuard.Camera`.

# 8b. THE DEPTH SHRINK — SCOPE IS LOOSE CONTENTS ONLY
**⚠ BUILDINGS DO NOT SHRINK: ALLOW-LIST ON `ThingDef.category`** (Item, Plant, Filth). **Pawns DO shrink.**
**⚠ TERRAIN IS NEVER SHRUNK.** HARD rule.
**⚠ THE PAWN MATRIX CARRIES TWO EFFECTS, MULTIPLIED IN ONE POSTFIX.** No second `[HarmonyPatch]` on `GetDrawParms`.
**⚠ AND FLECKS DO NOT SHRINK EITHER** (§39) - same reason as realtime things: no matrix funnel.

# 9. GENERATION COST
**9a.** The profile stamps its own conditions; has voided or explained EIGHT comparisons. **⚠ THE WATER REPORT DOES NOT AND SHOULD.**
**OLD best:** #255 5x190 Boreal ~4.1 s. **NEW (all 5x126):** #278 ~1.6 s | #294-#315 Mountainous ExtremeDesert ~3.1 s (carve 1,998 ms).
**#384 Flat BorealForest 5x126: gensteps 1,071 ms + carve 707 ms.** FillRock band 0 only **273 ms** against #315's 1,575 ms on Mountainous - **the cleanest confirmation yet that FillRock tracks HILLINESS, not band size alone.** Sky clear ~117-142 ms per sky band. Plants 325 ms (rainfall 1386).
**⚠ FillRock is SUPERLINEAR in band size.** **⚠ RAINFALL DOMINATES `GenStep_Plants`** (21x). **⚠ THE `Caves` CLAIM IS DEMOTED.** **⚠ HILLINESS DECIDES WHETHER A RENDERING - OR PATHING - TEST IS VALID AT ALL.**
**⚠ `RecalculateAllPerceivedPathCosts` RUNS AT EVERY `Map.FinalizeInit`, ONCE PER `PathGridDef` WITH A WORKER.**
**9g.** 1. **Basement rock suppression**. 2. `GenStep_Plants` (demoted). 3. `GenStep_RockChunks`. 4. Ruins. 5. Perlin precompute.

# 10-12. PERF AND DIAGNOSTICS
59.6 fps at 96 pawns. **⚠ THAT MEASURES THE WRONG THING** - cost is in BURSTS. **§36 caught them: the 83-100 ms worst frames are the mirrored-regen bursts.**
**⚠ BISECT TOGGLES PERSIST ACROSS RUNS; THE STAMP IS WHY WE CATCH IT.**
**⚠ The palette always strips its LAST entry. n=28.** Pad with a DISTINCT throwaway. **#384: an INVALID pad works too and says so - `Could not find node from path '...'. Removing.`**
**⚠ OUR REPORT LINES ARRIVE AS `warning` ROWS ATTRIBUTED TO US.** **Info is filtered out of the bridge.** **⚠ Multi-line reports: the auto-prompt shows only the FIRST line - `monitor_get_error` returns the body, and re-runs of the same report are the SAME class (edge-triggered, silent) - poll and re-drill for the LATEST body.**
**⚠⚠ AND THAT MAKES A RE-FIRING DIAGNOSTIC INVISIBLE.** #384: the STUCK class had already fired once, so a SECOND stuck pawn would never have auto-prompted. **After any change whose success is "the diagnostic stays quiet", `monitor_poll` and read the COUNT - silence in the prompt stream is not evidence.**
**⚠⚠ A CLEAN LOG IS NOT A WORKING FEATURE.** What a clean run does prove: no `Skipped patch class` means every patch resolved.
**⚠⚠ ASK FOR THE EXISTING DIAGNOSTIC BEFORE THE FIRST GUESS.** **⚠⚠ AND THEN CHECK THE DIAGNOSTIC CAN EXPRESS THE FAILURE** (§33h). **⚠⚠ WHEN YOU CANNOT TELL WHICH PATCH DID IT, TRAP THE SHARED FUNNEL.** **⚠ A DIAGNOSTIC MUST PRINT THE INTERMEDIATE VALUES, NOT THE VERDICT.**
**⚠ AN ERROR HASH IS A STACK SIGNATURE, NOT A FILE.** **⚠ COUNTER PAIRS THAT SHOULD TRACK 1:1 ARE A FREE CROSS-CHECK.**
**⚠ CIRCINUS: run docs at `<savedata>\Circinus\Runs\*.json`, minified single-line JSON with an embedded `_readme` contract. Parse with python; no jq on this box.**

# 13. OPEN WORK
1. **ART.** 87 of 90 riser placeholders - a public promise.
2. **§40 MINING ROUTER** - the one known gameplay bug. Highest priority of the code items.
3. **CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT: upward shooting does not render.**
4. **§38b + §39b: VERIFY the load reset and the below-flecks** (signatures there).
5. **§36f: VERIFY C1+B1**, plus the unflown stress runs: warm same-band pathfind, cross-band guard stress, spawn-20-below, bills on a REAL colony.
6. **Watchdog occupant field is SELF-BLIND when `nextCell == Position`** - it prints `occupant=none` because the only pawn there is the reporting pawn itself, which is exactly the case that fires (#384). Print co-located pawns explicitly.
7. **`ARRIVED-NO-PENDING` false positive** (#384): `Carry` clears `everSegmented` up front, then its own `StartPath` re-enters `TrySegment` which can re-add it, so the flag outlives the journey and a later ordinary arrival warns about a failure that did not happen. Clear where the record is CONSUMED, not optimistically at the start.
8. **VERIFY §33g, §8b, §30a, §25.** 9. **VERIFY §32a with a raid.**
10. **§35a NOT COVERED: `ClosestThing_Global_Reachable` callers.** Extend only with evidence.
11. **§33c entry animation: redesign from outside the carry decision, or drop it.**
12. **Basement rock suppression.** 13. **§30 polish.** 14. §18 audit; VEE compat; GL roof fix; reroll grid; camera anchor; preview at 254.
15. **Never exercised:** cavern basement. 16. §22 TABLED. 17. CAI 5000. 18. §30g. 19. §30e Rimefeller oil.
20. **Delete orphaned Workshop item 3773267907.** 21. **B3 (lighting Mesh reuse).**

# 14. LESSONS
**Method.** Prove a subsystem innocent by finding a state where the suspect CANNOT EXIST. Change one thing per experiment. **Run the diagnostic before the first theory.**
**⚠⚠ COUNT THE EMITTERS - AND COUNT THE HOMES.** Promoted to a top-four rule. §39: the below view had THREE draw sources and mirrored two. §38: pawn session state had FIVE static homes and reset none. **Both were sets assumed complete without ever being enumerated.** When you fix "the last one", write down how many there are.
**⚠⚠ A DERIVED ANSWER CANNOT BE MORE ACCURATE THAN ITS SOURCE** (§34b).
**⚠⚠ AN INSTRUMENT GATED ON THE SYMPTOM'S OPPOSITE FLAG IS BLIND BY CONSTRUCTION** (§33h). **When a diagnostic has never fired, ask what state it CANNOT observe.**
**⚠⚠ EVERY EXIT FROM A TELEPORT MUST RE-DISPATCH OR END THE JOB** (§33h). `Notify_Teleported` stops the pather DEAD without telling the JobDriver.
**⚠⚠ STATIC STATE KEYED BY thingIDNumber IS SHARED WITH EVERY GAME YOU LOAD** (§38) - and IDs are STABLE across a save lineage, so it re-binds to live pawns instead of harmlessly missing. **⚠ AND A TICK-BASED EXPIRY CANNOT CLEAN IT UP, BECAUSE LOADING AN EARLIER SAVE REWINDS THE CLOCK.** A cleanup whose condition is `now > expiry` is disabled for the whole rewind - which is why the report was specifically about PRIOR saves.
**⚠⚠ A BUG REPORT THAT NAMES ONE PAWN TYPE IS NOT NECESSARILY TYPE-SPECIFIC** (§33h was universal; §37 was genuinely mech-only). **Find the mechanism before you scope the fix.**
**⚠⚠ ONE USER GESTURE CAN HAVE THREE CODE PATHS** (§33f).
**⚠⚠ A COSMETIC EFFECT MUST NEVER SIT ON THE DECIDING PATH** (§33c). **⚠⚠ CLAMP AT SELECTION, NEVER AT MOVEMENT** (§35).
**⚠⚠ WHEN THE REVERT DOES NOT FIX IT, THE HYPOTHESIS WAS WRONG - STOP EXTENDING IT.**
**⚠⚠ CHECK WHETHER IT IS ALREADY BUILT - AND WHETHER THE MISTAKE IS ALREADY DOCUMENTED.**
**⚠ THE SAME GUARD CAN BE RIGHT FOR ONE CONSUMER AND WRONG FOR ANOTHER** (§40). "Unknown island means leave it alone" is correct for the §35a CLAMP and wrong for the ROUTER, and both read the same `ComponentOf < 0`. **A shared helper's contract is per caller, not global.**
**⚠ COUNT THE CONSUMERS BEFORE BLAMING A CHECK** (§37): six call sites, all order paths, is what proved mech WORK selection innocent.
**⚠ NOT EVERY BRANCH OF A FUNNEL LIES EQUALLY** (§35a).
**⚠ A THRESHOLD ON A FAST-PATH FLAG NEEDS A MINIMUM MAGNITUDE.** **⚠ VISIBILITY-GATE A MARKER, GEOMETRICALLY LIFT A CHAIN.** **⚠ WHEN A CORE FEATURE REGRESSES, REVERT FIRST.** **⚠ A CORRECT PRINCIPLE APPLIED TO THE WRONG THING IS STILL A BUG.** **⚠ A GUARD THAT FIRES UNCONDITIONALLY IS NOT A GUARD THAT FIRES ON ITS TRIGGER.** **⚠ WHEN YOU MAKE TWO THINGS AGREE, ASK WHICH ONE IS RIGHT.** **⚠ "NOT SAME" IS NOT "KNOWN DIFFERENT".** **⚠ AN ARITHMETIC SIGNATURE NAMES THE GUILTY METHOD.** **⚠ FIXING A HELPER DOES NOT FIX ITS CALL SITES.** **⚠ THREE COPIES OF ONE TRANSFORM, TWO RIGHT.** **⚠ A SYMPTOM CAN BE FOUR DEFECTS.** **⚠ COPY A LOOP'S DIRECTION TOO.** **⚠ A STATELESS EFFECT IS WORTHLESS IF ITS INPUT NEVER CHANGES.** **⚠ REUSING A RADIUS IS REUSING ITS REASONS.** **⚠ NEVER CALL A SYNCHRONOUS PATHFIND FROM A DRAW CALLBACK.** **⚠ WHEN THE USER PROPOSES A FIX, CHECK WHETHER THE PREMISE IS ALREADY TRUE.** **⚠ A BURST-COMPILED METHOD CANNOT BE PATCHED AND FAILS SILENTLY.** **⚠ A PERFORMANCE CLAIM COPIED INTO THREE FILES IS STILL ONE CLAIM.** **⚠ THE CHEAPEST OPTIMISATION IS DELETING WORK THAT CANNOT MATTER** (§39's view-band gate is this rule applied at authoring time rather than after a profile). **⚠ AN OVERLAY MUST AGREE WITH WHERE THE RENDERER PUTS THE THING.** **⚠ INSTRUMENTING THREE OF FIVE EARLY RETURNS IS THE SAME MISTAKE AS INSTRUMENTING NONE.** **⚠ THE AGENT'S TEST LOG IS NOT THE PROJECT'S TEST HISTORY.** **⚠ CHECK THAT YOUR CONFIGURATION CAN EXPRESS THE DIFFERENCE.** **⚠ A QUANTISED PARAMETER HAS FEWER LEGAL VALUES THAN IT LOOKS.** **⚠ A BUDGET SET BY THE HEAVIEST OPTION IS PAID BY EVERY USER.** **⚠ A COST MODEL CAN GOVERN THE WRONG AXIS.** **⚠ IF THE CHEAPEST OPTION LOOKS MOST EXPENSIVE, THE UI IS LYING.** **⚠ n=2 IS NOT A PATTERN, NOR n=4.** **⚠ HALF-IMPOSED ORDERING IS WORSE THAN NONE.** **⚠ CLEAR THE OTHER SUSPECT BY READING ITS DATA.** **⚠ A FIX FOR MOD X CAN REGRESS EVERYONE WITHOUT X.** **⚠ REPRODUCING A SUBSYSTEM MEANS ALL OF IT.** **⚠ REUSING A PREDICATE IS REUSING ITS HIDDEN CONDITIONS.** **⚠ TWO RESOLVERS FOR ONE QUANTITY IS A BUG WITH A DELAY FUSE.** **⚠ N MODS CAN BE FEWER THAN N PROBLEMS.** **⚠ A FOREIGN MOD'S OWN DEFS CAN BE WRONG.** **⚠ A DEPENDENCY LIST NAMES THE REAL PATCH TARGET.** **⚠ AN ENUM IS A CAPABILITY LIST.** **⚠ A DECOMPILE SHOWS THE API OF THE VERSION IT WAS BUILT AGAINST.** **⚠ Compat work is mostly deletion.** **⚠ A comment gone FALSE is worse than none.** **⚠ Steady-state fps hides burst cost.** **⚠ 0.0 ms is an early return.** **⚠ In a foreign log the loudest error is downstream.** **⚠ A HIGH-FREQUENCY PATCH'S COST IS DISPATCH x CALL COUNT, NOT ITS BODY.** **⚠ WHEN AN EDIT APPENDS A catch TO A METHOD THAT ALREADY HAS ONE, THE ORIGINAL ORPHANS INSIDE YOUR NEW BLOCK.**
**Patching.** **Wrap the DATA instead of the reader.** Patch the PRODUCER (§39 mirrors at `CreateFleck`, not at draw). Own the widget. **No foreign types in patch signatures; omit private nested structs.** **Prefix state releases in a Finalizer.** **Detect-then-redo over always-redo** - and **local-pass-then-vanilla with a `[ThreadStatic]` latch** (recursion without it is an UNCATCHABLE StackOverflow). **⚠ RE-ENTER THE PATCHED METHOD WITH CORRECTED INPUTS RATHER THAN COPYING ITS CONSTANTS** (§37). **⚠ PREFER A VANILLA EVENT TO A PATCH ON A HOT METHOD.** **⚠ REIMPLEMENT RATHER THAN POSTFIX WHEN THE GEOMETRY IS A CHAIN.** **⚠ GATE A HOT PATCH'S LIFETIME, NOT ITS BODY (§36e-C1).** **⚠ AND WHEN LIFETIME GATING IS OVERKILL, GATE ON THE OBSERVER** (§39): a mirror nobody can currently see is work that cannot matter, and "is the player looking from above" is two int compares.
**Engine facts.** `SnowGrid.CanHaveSnow` rejects on `holdSnowOrSand=false` OR Full-fillage. **`SnowGrid.TotalDepth` is the cheap probe.** `TerrainHard` IGNORES vertex alpha; `renderQueue` AFTER shader. A `dontRender` terrain emits only a ShadowMask. `Banded` is FALSE during generation. FinalizeInit runs on a worker thread. Gensteps run with bookkeeping DEFERRED. Harmony always runs FINALIZERS. `FogGrid` is a `NativeBitArray`. `Graphic_Multi.Init` falls back `_east`+`westFlipped`. **`DebugAction`/`AllowedGameStates` live in `LudeonTK`.** **`ABBandMap.BandOf` CLAMPS - there is no "not in a band" answer.** **⚠ DISCARDING A GAME DOES NOT DESPAWN ITS THINGS** (§38): an orphaned building can still report `Spawned == true`, and its `Map` resolves against the NEW game's map list.
**⚠⚠ PATHING vs REGION FACTS (§34).** **A region is a CELL SET; path production ALSO refuses diagonal corners.** **`map.pathing.Normal` is the `PathingContext`.** **`TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`: ~4,500 calls/frame, NEVER patch.** `Region.AnyCell` is inside the region; `extentsClose.CenterCell` is NOT. **A region never straddles the gutter.** **⚠ AN IMPASSABLE CELL HAS NO REGION AND THEREFORE NO ISLAND** - mining, deconstruct, smoothing and roof targets all read `ComponentOf == -1` (§40).
**⚠⚠ PATHER LIFECYCLE FACTS (§33h).** **`Notify_Teleported(endCurrentJob:false)` -> `Notify_Teleported_Int()` -> `StopDead()`: releases `curPath`, sets `moving=false`, NEVER notifies the JobDriver.** **`ToilCompleteMode.PatherArrival` is PUSH-completed.** **`StartPath` opens with `if (AtDestinationPosition()) { PatherArrived(); return; }`.** **`StopDead` leaves `destination` STALE-VALID.** **⚠ `PatherTick`'s FIRST branch is `WillCollideWithPawnAt(Position)`: two pawns in one cell with no free neighbour sets `failedToFindCloseUnoccupiedCellTicks` and early-returns every tick, leaving `moving=true` and `nextCell == Position` forever** - the #384 GotoWander stall, and vanilla's own behaviour.
**⚠ DRAW FACTS (§39).** **THREE emitters: map mesh SectionLayers / `dynamicDrawManager.DrawThings` / `map.flecks`.** **Flecks are NOT Things** - structs owned by FleckSystems, batched, invisible to any thing-based mirror. `FleckManager.parent` is a public readonly Map; `FleckCreationData` is a public struct; `CreateFleck` overwrites `spawnPosition.y` from the def's altitude layer. **An ATTACHED fleck follows its target and ignores a moved spawnPosition - clear `link` on a mirrored copy.**
**⚠ SELECTION FACTS (§35).** **`GenClosest.ClosestThingReachable` is the work/haul funnel.** **A NON-NULL priorityGetter validates EVERY candidate.** **Only 4 vanilla scanners are `Prioritized`.** **Bills do NOT use GenClosest at all.** **⚠ `MaxRegionsToScanBeforeGlobalSearch` is -1 for EVERY vanilla scanner except `WorkGiver_CleanFilth` (4)** - the global fallback is open, so cross-band work selection is not structurally blocked (§37b).
**⚠ ORDERING FACTS (§33f).** ONE pawn -> `PawnGotoAction`; TWO+ -> `MultiPawnGotoController`. **⚠ AND IT SILENTLY DROPS OUT-OF-RANGE MECHS** (§37).
**⚠ RENDERER FACTS.** Past `ZoomRootSize` 18: cached atlas blit ignores `PawnDrawParms.matrix` - `disableCache`. `GetDrawParms` reaches WORKER THREADS. A uniform x/z Scale right-multiplies; a TRANSLATION cannot. **A camera-culled thing keeps `results.valid` STALE.** **A below-pawn's serial three-phase draw costs ~one `RenderPawnAt` (~27 µs).**
**⚠ WALL-MOUNT / POWER / PATHFINDER FACTS.** Draw layer `Item`; south offset 0 vs N/E/W 0.9. `ContiguousPowerBuildings` PRIVATE; `ConnectMaxDist = 6`; **a `private const` is INLINED.** `PathGridJob` deduped per VARIANT per tick; `calcGrid.Clear()` is the per-request cost; `FindPathNow` is SYNCHRONOUS; **`PawnPath` is POOLED**; **the first synchronous request of a session can pay ~1.5 s of warmup.**
**⚠ `HashSet<T>` lacks non-generic `ICollection`.** **⚠ Core textures are PACKED; two art families.**

**16.** Melt per band rewrites `outdoorMeltAmount`; ReGrowth composes. **✅ §36e-C1 lifetime-gates the `DoCellSteadyEffects` pair.**

## 33h. THE TRANSIT DISPATCH HOLE — ✅ FIXED AND VERIFIED (#384)
**Reported as:** "I right click force them go down the stairs, then they get stuck just at the exit; I have to draft and undraft them." Reported for mechs; **it was never mech-specific.**
**Mechanism.** `Carry` ended with `... && !pawn.Position.Equals(realDest.Cell)) StartPath(...)`. That guard looks like an optimisation and is the bug: `Notify_Teleported` already ran `StopDead()`, so the pather holds no path and `moving=false`, **and the JobDriver was never told**. A `PatherArrival` toil is push-completed only, so the leg can never end; `jobs.StopAll()` (draft/undraft) is the only cure.
**Why THAT gesture.** `LandingCell` prefers the far anchor's own cell when free, so `Position == realDest.Cell` exactly when the ordered destination IS the stairwell.
**Fix: DELETE the guard.** `StartPath` opens with `if (AtDestinationPosition()) { PatherArrived(); return; }`, so vanilla produces a real arrival through our own prefix, and an unreachable destination becomes an honest `PatherFailed`. All three exits now re-dispatch or end the job.
**✅ VERIFIED #384:** Rubber, `job=Goto`, dest `(74,0,217)` == the far anchor. No stuck report, STUCK class stayed at ×1.
**⚠ THE TWIN WAS ALREADY RIGHT** - `TryConsumeArrival` returns false and lets vanilla arrive. Two triggers for one question, only one answered it.
**⚠ AND THE WATCHDOG COULD NOT SEE IT** - it required `moving=true`. Episode B added, discriminated by the toil's `defaultCompleteMode == PatherArrival` (read reflectively; `CurToil` is protected). Watch set widened to "near an anchor OR player faction".

# 38. PER-GAME STATIC STATE — 🔧 BUILT, UNVERIFIED

**Reported as:** "sometimes pawns refuse to move when you load a prior save, until they complete an action on the level they're on."

**38a. MECHANISM.** FIVE statics are keyed by `thingIDNumber` and none were reset on load: `ABWormholePather.pending` + `everSegmented`, `ABStairAnim.entering` + `popped`, `ABTransitVisuals.routes`, `ABStuckWatchdog.watching`. Statics live for the PROCESS; `[ABGameReset]` existed and was simply never applied to them.
**⚠ IDS ARE STABLE ACROSS A SAVE LINEAGE, SO THE STALE RECORDS DO NOT MISS - THEY BIND TO LIVE PAWNS.**
**⚠ AND DROPPING A GAME DOES NOT DESPAWN ITS THINGS**, so a stale record's anchor door can still report `Spawned == true`, and `door.Map` resolves its index against the NEW map list. Every liveness guard in the sweep was therefore satisfied by garbage.
**⚠⚠ "PRIOR SAVE" IS THE TELL.** Loading an EARLIER save rewinds `TicksGame`, so `now > expiresAtTick` is false for the whole rewind and the 4000-tick self-cleanup - the thing that hides this in ordinary play - cannot fire at all.
**Fix.** `[ABGameReset]` on all five, plus a rewind-proof expiry: `int left = expiresAtTick - now; if (left <= 0 || left > TransitTimeoutTicks) drop;` - the second test means "now is before this record was created".

**38b. VERIFICATION SIGNATURES.** Save mid-transit (a pawn walking to a stairwell), load an EARLIER save of the same colony, and order that pawn around: it must move immediately, with no teleport toward a destination from the previous session and no `ARRIVED-ANCHOR-GONE`. `AB2: transit health` right after a load must print `pending transits: 0`.

# 39. THE THIRD DRAW EMITTER: FLECKS — 🔧 BUILT, UNVERIFIED

**Reported as:** "you can't see things like horseshoes being thrown from upper layers."

**39a. MECHANISM.** `Horseshoe` is a **FleckDef**. The below view mirrors the map mesh (SectionLayers) and `dynamicDrawManager.DrawThings` (pawns, then realtime things - itself a late discovery). **Flecks are neither**: they are structs owned by `FleckSystem`s and drawn in FleckManager's own batch, so no thing-based mirror can ever reach them however complete it becomes. Scope is far wider than horseshoes - sparks, dust, splashes, smoke and most pre-1.3 motes are flecks.
**Fix: MIRROR AT THE PRODUCER.** Postfix `FleckManager.CreateFleck`, re-issue a copy with `spawnPosition.z + dz`, `[ThreadStatic]` latch against re-entry. **⚠ CLEAR `link` ON THE COPY** - an attached fleck follows its target's real position and would snap back down.
**⚠ GATED ON THE VIEW BAND, WHICH IS WHAT MAKES IT AFFORDABLE.** `CreateFleck` is high-frequency; the gate rejects the whole common case (viewing the fleck's own band) in two int compares before touching terrain. Mirroring to every see-through band above would multiply every surface fleck by the sky-stack depth, permanently, for something nobody is looking at.
**⚠ THE DESCENT TEST IS `TryResolveVisibleBelow`, NOT `- Slot`** - the one-descent rule, already mis-implemented eight times.

**39b. VERIFICATION SIGNATURES.** Stand on band N+1 looking down through open air at a horseshoe pin on band N: the horseshoes must be visible in flight. `AB2: render report` -> `below flecks: M mirrored of C considered`; **C must be non-zero whenever you are viewing a band from above** - C staying 0 means the gate is wrong, not that the map is quiet, which is exactly why both numbers are printed. Then check a solid floor: standing above an ENCLOSED room, its flecks must NOT show through.

# 40. OPEN BUG: THE MINING ROUTER (found #384, NOT fixed)

**Signature:** `TRANSIT: Erika (79,0,352) (band 2) comp 2000000 -> (65,0,85) (band 0) comp -1 | job=Mine | transit=NONE (pawn will try to walk it and fail)`.

**Mechanism.** `ABWormhole.TryGetTransit` opens with `if (compFrom < 0 || compTo < 0 || compFrom == compTo) return false;`, commented "an endpoint with no region at all ... nothing we can help with". **A mine target is solid rock, so it HAS no region and `ComponentOf` returns -1 by construction.** The router declines, `TrySegment` bails, and the pawn is handed a destination the pathfinder cannot reach: `CanReach=True` + `path=NOT FOUND`, the §34 stall.
**Scope is every job whose target is an impassable cell:** mining, deconstructing/repairing a wall, smoothing, roof work on rock. **It matters more here than it would anywhere else, because the basement ships as solid rock and mining is the primary thing you do down there.**
**⚠⚠ AND IT IS THE SAME `ComponentOf < 0` THAT §34c IS RIGHT ABOUT.** "Unknown means leave alone" is correct for the §35a CLAMP (do not demote a candidate you cannot judge) and wrong for the ROUTER (do not refuse a trip you can obviously make). **Same helper, opposite correct answers - fix the ROUTER only, and do not touch §35a's guard.**
**Proposed fix.** When `compTo < 0`, resolve the destination to the island of an adjacent walkable cell in the same band - the cells the pawn would actually stand on to touch the target - and only fail if none of those resolves either. Same treatment for `compFrom < 0` (a pawn standing in a doorway or on a region-less cell).
**Not caused by the #384 changes** - `TryGetTransit` is untouched by them - and **not** the constructoid resource-fetch report, since a blueprint sits on a walkable cell.
